screening_order_basis: data and implementation readiness, not a numeric score ranking
metric_direction: official distance-weighted Tversky index; higher DTI is better

candidates.name: Lithology-conditioned potassium residual halos
candidates.target_physical_signature: Robust K-on-Th residual anomaly field; retain spatially coherent positive residuals, without catalogue-distance or label inputs.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: Potassic alteration related to hydrothermal fluid pathways may extend under cover or beyond mapped surface-fault traces; radiometric anomalies are not direct fault observations.
candidates.prior_art_distinction: H50-B used low-Th/K ratios in D-S conflict corridors and H53-RadEdge used radiometric edges. Residualization/coherence is a different operator, but prior radiometric evidence is closely related; no concept-level novelty claim.

expected_dti_impact.planning_range: +0.000 to +0.003 public-proxy DTI, copied from a post-score exploratory note only
expected_dti_impact.caveat: Not measured and not a leaderboard forecast; zero or negative impact remains plausible.

candidates.implementation_cost: Low to medium; local raster, robust background model, quantization/nodata review, controls, spatial holdout.

data_availability.limitation: 0 may be source nodata and the local raster is an owner mirror, not organizer-authenticated; useful-zero semantics, full valid support, and reuse terms need review.

candidates.name: Buried basement-step edge concordance
candidates.target_physical_signature: Multi-scale basement-depth curvature co-located with gravity-gradient and conductivity boundaries.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: A basement offset beneath basin fill can be geophysically expressed where a generalized surface-fault inventory and topographic scarp are absent.
candidates.prior_art_distinction: H55-C proposed basement-depth conjunction but no matching multiscale edge-concordance prediction and blocked receipt was found; not a global novelty claim.

expected_dti_impact.caveat: Band screening is not a candidate result; no numeric DTI delta is defensible before a mass-matched spatial holdout.

candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; re-fetch/restore feature stack, audit units and nodata, freeze edge scales/masks, then test.

data_availability.limitations: Organizer data tab is login-gated in this environment; prior bytes were matched to a sibling-repository mirror, not organizer-authenticated. Earlier screen had 3061 in-footprint nodata cells. Restore and re-audit before use.

candidates.name: Channel-profile knickpoint clusters
layers: derived channel network and long profiles
candidates.target_physical_signature: Profile second-derivative maxima over a frozen noise floor, clustered into azimuth-coherent channel-break corridors.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: Fault-related base-level perturbation may create aligned knickpoints upstream of a visible scarp, including under alluvial cover; climate, lithology, incision, and human works are confounders.
candidates.prior_art_distinction: H52/H54 use hillslope step detectors and H53-A uses grid-scale strike-coherent scarp persistence; no channel long-profile operator was found in the reviewed source tree.

expected_dti_impact.planning_range: +0.002 to +0.010 public-proxy DTI, copied from a post-score exploratory note only
expected_dti_impact.caveat: Not a measured result; zero or negative impact remains plausible.

candidates.implementation_cost: Medium-high; full-area DEM mosaic, hydrologic conditioning, detector implementation, controls, and blocked evaluation.

data_availability.limitation: Full-area 3m DEM required for channel profiles is absent in the current checkout; a scarp-summary mosaic and two pilot tiles do not establish complete coverage.

candidates.name: Airborne magnetic analytic-signal and tilt ridges
candidates.target_physical_signature: Multi-scale analytic-signal magnitude or tilt-angle edge ridges continued under basin cover.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: A basement fault may juxtapose magnetized units without preserving a surface scarp; lithologic contacts and cultural noise can mimic the signal.
candidates.prior_art_distinction: H53-RadEdge uses radiometric K/Th/U/TC edges; previous H49/H53 slates proposed magnetic methods but no matching local magnetic candidate was found. This is unimplemented, not globally novel.

expected_dti_impact.caveat: Source metadata cannot establish DTI sign or magnitude.

candidates.implementation_cost: High; acquire/regrid, verify overlap/resolution and flight-line artifacts, freeze transform, then block-test.

data_availability.limitation: Local file is radiometry, not magnetic data; exact magnetic product coverage/resolution in the competition footprint is unverified. See docs/research/data-availability-geochem-magnetic-20261007.md.

candidates.name: Method-stratified geochemical pathfinder anomalies
layers: USGS National Geochemical Survey coordinates and analytes (for example As, Li, Hg, B after data dictionary review)
candidates.target_physical_signature: Spatially coherent, method-normalized pathfinder residuals with explicit sample-density and censoring uncertainty.
candidates.off_catalogue_rationale: Hydrothermal geochemistry may extend beyond mapped surface traces; stream transport, lithology, sample media, detection limits, and uneven sampling can dominate.
candidates.prior_art_distinction: H48-2 considered SGMC mapped-contact topology; radiometric and temperature candidates use different measurements. No National Geochemical Survey predictor layer was found in the reviewed outputs.

expected_dti_impact.caveat: No sample payload or in-footprint count is available to support a numeric expectation.

candidates.implementation_cost: High; download, schema/media/method audit, censored-value handling, spatial-support model, and blocked evaluation.

data_availability.metadata_available: Repository source check recorded public geographic packages: 74409-sample shapefile and 77212-record CSV.
data_availability.limitation: No in-footprint sample count, unit/media/method audit, detection-limit review, or asset-level reuse clearance is recorded. See docs/research/data-availability-geochem-magnetic-20261007.md.
